plotSections.title: The Chosen Responsibility
bullets: The entire party steps forward to join Gerk in the mysterious venture offered to him, accepting a shared responsibility connected to the Eldarin Tree and the Mother's Prayer.
Gawater explains that Gerk is being recognized as a 'son of the great tree' and that the party members who join him are taking on the responsibility alongside him.
Glimmen respectfully acknowledges the proceedings while the other powerful figures present, including Kit Anger and Juten Prime, step back and allow the event to unfold without intervention.

plotSections.title: The Eldarin Tree and the Mother's Prayer
bullets: Gawater reveals that the Eldarin Tree is a great and sacred tree of the Navi and one of the most significant magical places in Atlas.
The Eldarin Tree has rings like Atlas itself. The Navi studied and distilled knowledge from those rings, ultimately creating the keystones from that process.

The creation of the keystones unintentionally set events into motion and began the Mother's Prayer, a prophecy that appears to propagate itself whenever individuals are needed to act for the health and prosperity of Atlas.
Gerk is being 'plucked' from the tree like ripe fruit, taking on a responsibility intended to serve not merely the Eldarin Tree but the wellbeing of all Atlas.

plotSections.title: Gerk, the Doorman
bullets: Gawater offers Gerk the title of Doorman, apparently the first such title granted in many years.
The Doorman has the ability to open and close an Arch, reach out and connect with that Arch, and is responsible for protecting it.
Gerk accepts the role and is given the opportunity to choose which Arch he will serve.

plotSections.title: Choosing a Keystone
bullets: Plymouth Gawater removes a keystone from one of the concentric circles in the floor and presents it to Gerk as the keystone to Pitel.
Gerk learns that he can choose which keystone to hold and asks the party for advice.
The party identifies Feldspar as the science, alchemy, and technology-oriented realm; Gilbrick as a dangerous or frightening realm; and Lith as a realm whose inhabitants have largely rejected magic.
Gerk is not interested in choosing Gilbrick, while Feldspar is described as an appealing possibility. The transcript ends while the party is still discussing the available choices.

plotSections.title: Daisy's Appearance
bullets: Dana points out that the unexplained flowers associated with the recent events match Daisy's distinctive signature, leading the party to conclude that Daisy was present.
The DM acknowledges that Daisy's presence is troublesome and says he will need to consult his notes to explain it.

chronologicalEvents: Dana connects the unexplained flowers to Daisy's signature and concludes that Daisy was present.
The DM calls Dana, Gerk, Walker, Ord, Sylan, and Ciri forward to participate in the ceremony.
Ciri teleports to Ben before rejoining the party in the center of the dais.
The entire party chooses to step forward and join Gerk in the venture despite not yet knowing all of its responsibilities.
Kit Anger and Juten Prime step back and allow the ceremony to proceed without intervention.
Gawater explains that Gerk is a 'son of the great tree' and identifies the Eldarin Tree as sacred to the Navi.
Gawater reveals that the Navi created the keystones by studying and distilling knowledge from the rings of the Eldarin Tree.
The creation of the keystones unintentionally initiated the Mother's Prayer, a self-propagating prophecy that calls forth individuals when Atlas needs them.
Gerk accepts responsibility as a chosen individual connected to the Eldarin Tree, with the rest of the party joining him in that responsibility.
Gawater offers Gerk the title of Doorman, giving him the power and responsibility to open and close an Arch and protect it.
Gerk accepts the role of Doorman.
Plymouth Gawater retrieves a keystone from the concentric circles and presents Gerk with the keystone to Pitel as his first potential choice.
The party discusses the characteristics of Pitel, Feldspar, Gilbrick, and Lith while helping Gerk decide which keystone to choose.

newTerms.name: Son of the Great Tree
notes: A designation applied to Gerk in connection with the Eldarin Tree and his selection by the Mother's Prayer.

newTerms.name: Eldarin Tree

newTerms.name: Mother's Prayer
notes: A prophecy unintentionally initiated through the creation of the keystones.
